description: Accepting generated code without reading or testing it, iterating by pasting errors back. Coined by Andrej Karpathy for throwaway projects.
Simon Willison's name for experienced developers using agents while staying accountable for what they ship; superseded by "agentic engineering".
Building production software with agents you orchestrate and oversee, with tests, specs, review and measurement. Proposed by Karpathy as the name for the disciplined practice.
Plausible, low-quality generated content or code produced in volume and accepted without review.
The DORA report's framing: AI magnifies a team's existing strengths and dysfunctions rather than fixing them.
